name: Werner Herzog
original_name: ヴェルナー・ヘルツォーク
source:
Louise's target. 

The heir to a Mafia family. He exudes masculine charms, captivating the hearts of women everywhere he goes. He loves cigars, and often has four or more beautiful women at his side. He's proud and quick-thinking.

[From in-game profile]
